title: Patch rules
description: What the apply-patch script is to admit from a producer's patch: one row per prepare mode a patch-producing skill uses, `default` for one with no prepare mode, and `issue` for a patch that goes to a new issue-lane branch. Contract: docs/conventions/pr-pipeline/README.md, Patch rules.

refuse.description: Named refusals; any match refuses the whole patch. github: .github/** in any case and through any .. segment; claude: .claude/** at any depth; mcp-config: the root .mcp.json; gitmodules: .gitmodules; settings: **/settings*.json; symlink: mode 120000; gitlink: mode 160000; new-executable: an executable bit on a file not already executable; rename-into-refused: a rename whose new path another refusal matches.

allow.description: What a path the refusals pass must also meet. any: nothing more; kept-threads: the path of a thread the run kept; dependency-manifests: an npm or pip manifest or lock file outside .github/; merge-result: the blob the base merge leaves there, or a conflicted path left with no conflict markers.

max-files.description: The most paths one patch may change; null for no limit.

requires.description: What the producer's output must say before any path is applied.

parents.description: The commit's parents: the producer's head, then the trusted base tip for a merge.

message.description: The subject, with {ref}, {base}, {lane}, {activity} and {issue} filled in by apply-patch.

trailer.description: The trailer line that names the activity, with {lane} and {activity} filled in.

reads-report.description: The producer report apply-patch reads; ci-escalations: the checks the model escalated.

escalations.description: The escalation reasons apply-patch may give for this row.
